newsitem.title: JAPAN: Janome shares ask-only on bath units report. [CORRECTED 03:07 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Janome shares ask-only on bath units report. [CORRECTED 03:07 GMT]

text.p: Shares in Janome Sewing Machine Co Ltd were ask-only on Monday morning, hit by a newspaper report that health concerns had forced eight housing equipment makers, not including Janome, to stop selling "24-hour bath" systems, traders said (corrects to make clear that Janome was not one of the eight firms).
Janome's shares were ask-only at 260 yen at midday, down from Friday's close of 300 yen.

The business daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun said on Sunday that the eight makers had decided to halt sales of the units, in which the water is automatically purified, circulated and kept warm, due to concerns that the baths could breed a pneumonia-causing bacteria.
Janome is one of the major producers of the bath systems.
A spokesman for Janome told Reuters on Monday: "We will continue to produce and sell 24-hour bath systems."
Shares in the eight housing equipment makers also fell, with Inax Corp down 18 yen at 802 yen at midday.
